blocks.text: SaaS Workflows in the Zscaler Admin Console offer a way to automate routine, manual tasks across your SaaS applications through the creation and execution of automated workflows. This automation helps maintain consistent security and compliance for data at rest by orchestrating actions such as bulk remediation, access and content clean-up, and exposure reduction, thereby minimizing the need for repetitive administrator intervention.
The workflows operate based on a set of predefined rules and logic, ensuring consistency and accuracy across all operations.
The SaaS Workflows page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Reduce administrative overhead by automating repetitive tasks that save time and minimize manual effort.

Provides improved user productivity and data at rest protection by reducing exposure and accelerating cleanup and bulk remediation, so users can stay focused, while keeping data at rest secure and compliant across SaaS applications.

blocks.text: On the SaaS Workflows page (Data Security > DSPM > Workflows), you can view the following:

blocks.item: View the Microsoft Copilot Readiness Assessment page.
Remediation Jobs:
In Progress: Click to view the remediation jobs that are currently in progress. You can view the following information with regard to the individual assets:
Job ID: A unique ID generated by the bulk remediation action. You can click the job ID to view all the job details in the Job Details drawer.
See image.
Policy Action: Name of the remediation action performed.
Progress: Progress of the activity.
Asset Owner: Owner of the assets.
Assets: Number of assets.
Created By: Email address of the admin who created the job.
See image.
Completed: Click to view the completed remediation jobs. You can view the following information with regard to the individual assets:

Job ID: A unique ID generated by the bulk remediation action. You can click the job ID to view all the job details in the Job Details drawer. Clicking View Logs redirects you to the SaaS Security Insights Logs page.
See image.
Policy Action: Name of the remediation action performed.
Result: Progress of the activity.
Asset Owner: Owner of the assets.
Assets: Number of assets.
Started On: Timestamp of when the activity was started.
Ended On: Timestamp of when the activity ended.
See image.
Job Search: Enter a part of the job ID or the complete job ID to find specific remediation jobs.
